idea-plugin.name: Copilot Architect
idea-plugin.description:
Configures GitHub Copilot Chat's Model Context Protocol connection to the local Copilot Architect server, so /mcp.copilot-architect.* commands (analyze, create-plan, implement, review) ground Copilot in this repository's real structure — the same repo intelligence the VS Code extension's @architect chat participant uses.

Requires Node.js 20.11 or later on this machine. This plugin has no repo-analysis logic of its own: it locates Node, extracts the bundled CLI, and points Copilot Chat's MCP configuration at it. Everything else — indexing, planning, grounding, applying an approved edit — happens in that already-built, already-tested CLI.

action.text: Set Up Copilot Architect MCP Server
action.description: Point GitHub Copilot Chat's MCP connection at this machine's Copilot Architect server
Register a folder's sub-directories as a multi-repo Copilot Architect workspace rooted at this project
